author: phx reporter
title: Phoenix Sky Harbor shares green award win and travel updates
text:
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport announced a series of updates and events through its official social media account on November 5, 2025. The airport shared news about receiving a major sustainability award, upcoming live music in the terminal, and anticipated flight delays due to air traffic constraints.
On November 5, 2025, Phoenix Sky Harbor reported: “Phoenix Sky Harbor was awarded the 2025 Airports Going Green Award for the PHX Green Business Partner Program! This award represents the airport’s efforts in innovation & leadership in aviation sustainability Learn more at https://t.co/cZHjzphwhg https://t.co/EodAWWlz9f”. The post highlights recognition for the airport’s environmental initiatives.
In another announcement posted later that day, the airport invited travelers to enjoy live classical music: “Tomorrow, enjoy classical music by violinist Cathie King at Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. She will perform live from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. in Terminal 3, Level 1 near Door 7. https://t.co/69cQGsJHOm https://t.co/XmUUzAKcVW” (November 5, 2025).
The airport also advised passengers about possible disruptions: “Due to air traffic capacity constraints, we’re anticipating delays. Please check your flight status with your airline before coming to the airport. You can also check TSA Security Checkpoint wait times on https://t.co/GMg4tp70FL and on the information displays in each terminal.” (November 5, 2025).
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport has seen recent developments aimed at enhancing passenger experience and expanding services. In August 2022, Breeze Airways began offering flights from Phoenix to Charleston and Provo out of Terminal 3 twice weekly (source). Additionally, leadership changes were made within the City of Phoenix Aviation Department around this time: Roxann Favors was appointed Assistant Director/Chief Revenue Officer (source), while Jay DeWitt took on the role of Assistant Director/Chief Development Officer overseeing planning and development divisions (source).
